name: C2PA / Content Credentials
notes: VeriScope reads C2PA-related XMP locally as a heuristic; full validation: use the open-source c2pa-tools CLI.

name: CIA World Factbook (archive)
notes: Discontinued 2026 — treat as ARCHIVED historical data; do not assume current. accessStatus should remain not-checked until verified.

name: Common Crawl
notes: Dataset access only; heavy. Use the index API manually.

name: CORE
notes: CORE API now requires a free key; treat as optional.

name: Discord
notes: No public search; manual-only by design.

name: DuckDuckGo (public search)
notes: Used as the generic site-scoped fallback: "site:domain query".

name: ExifTool (local CLI)
notes: Local forensic metadata; VeriScope embeds the open-source exifr reader for basic EXIF/XMP locally.

name: Facebook
notes: Access restrictions apply.

name: Financial Times
notes: Paywalled content: expect restricted access.

name: Google Lens
notes: Upload-by-URL: https://lens.google.com/uploadbyurl?url=IMAGE_URL (manual).

name: Google Scholar
notes: Rate-limited; no official API. Manual-first only.

name: Instagram
notes: Login required.

name: MITRE CVE
notes: cve.org search is unstable; MITRE API: https://cve.circl.lu/api/cve/CVE-ID mirrors freely.

name: National statistical agencies (via official portals)
notes: Start from the UN statistics division country directory.

name: PIB Fact Check
notes: Manual: uses interactive archive; narrow by date on site.

name: Reddit (public JSON)
notes: Rate limits and ToS apply; user-initiated navigation only.

name: Retraction Watch
notes: Database search itself needs a free registration; site search is open.

name: TikTok
notes: No free API; manual-first.

name: TinEye
notes: Free web search; API needs paid RapidAPI key — not integrated.

name: UN Comtrade
notes: Free account required now — treat as optional.

name: UN Official Document System
countries: Manual navigation: ODS search requires knowing document symbols.

name: US SEC EDGAR full-text search
notes: UI: https://www.sec.gov/edgar/search/ ; API is free with a declared User-Agent.

name: VirusTotal
notes: Public web UI rate-limited; API needs key — optional integration only.

name: World Bank Open Data API
notes: API adapter not implemented in v1 — used as a documented link only.

name: X (Twitter)
notes: Login walls restrict automated access; no free read API. Manual-first.

name: YouTube
notes: Automated API requires a free Google key (quota); scraping ToS-restricted. Manual-first.
